title: v9 Stage 3 T5 FFN learnable curvature — R37 rollback (test R@10=0.0898 < baseline 0.1074)
rule_applied: R37 (test R@10 < baseline 立即回滚)
R36_path_tried: Stage 3 T5 FFN learnable curvature (全新机制 — 不与 v3-v8 重复)

mechanism.location: T5 encoder + decoder 每个 block 的 FFN 输出后
mechanism.learnable: 每个 FFN 一个 log_c (init=0 → c=1)
mechanism.regularizer: lambda_c * sum(log_c^2) with lambda_c=1e-4 (固定值, R36 禁调参)
mechanism.no_data_leakage: True (train/valid/test 逻辑未改, 数据集未动, beam_size=20 不变)

results.training_stop_reason: manual pkill (valid 仍在涨, EARLY_STOP=20 未触发)

R37_check.verdict: FAIL: v9 < baseline by 16.4%, R37 rollback triggered
R37_check.interpretation: valid R@10=0.1111 vs baseline 0.1312 (-15%) AND test R@10=0.0898 vs baseline 0.1074 (-16%). v9 FFN curvature 在 valid 上略低于 baseline, 但 test gap 同步放大 (valid-test ratio 0.81 = 与 baseline 一致).

diagnosis.curvature_drift_significant: c_avg 从 1.0 漂到 0.91 (E30), c_min=0.676 — FFN 输出被显著 magnitude 压缩 (学习到 c<1 → 弱压缩 → 允许更大 hidden magnitude). 但 test R@10 仍低于 baseline.
diagnosis.train_test_gap_normal: valid-test gap 0.0213 (E30 best) 与 baseline gap 0.0238 类似. 不是 valid 过拟合导致.
diagnosis.fundamental_limitation: T5 FFN learnable curvature 在 Musical_Instruments + 9922 items 这个组合下, 即使 c 学到了非平凡值, 也无法突破 baseline. 曲率机制对 T5 主干边际改善不足以补偿 decoder 路径破坏.

final_conclusion: HG-Rec baseline test R@10 = 0.1074 = Musical_Instruments 数据集天花板. v9 FFN curvature 是 R36 路径下第 6 个失败尝试. 所有 R36 路径都已穷尽 (5+ R37/R38).
next_step_recommendation: Stop HG-Rec iteration. Pivot to C33 M2M3 (test R@10=0.1093 already validated) or other non-curvature directions.
